` [Highlight start] Sleep does not cure a hangover [Highlight end] ` , though resting helps you pass the time while your body recovers. Only time allows your liver to clear alcohol byproducts, rehydrate tissues, and restore normal brain function.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXnOWWpu2wOwxBCbDOpkIc-tSSkPSyUhtEPCpxzXY3fu6AVz26_5UfRg1Dyl0HaWIOck-dH9kjEKcOKyM-bg_hUUGPxRwUTX3O24FJ6ANQvHdJGFg3Zyh-2LiXTfnqN6v89yQzOV73o4WGh-D0VIlveeIGZw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXuzl1IMIy-x5NeyYxkCn-z5z_5mbFG236NKR2pII2c_qoy3_7OJrij0POXBLj2b3NaedVjp7P2J7AmEsg0U7LaE7A-zu9c8OGdU-qEK1hJxG0Sk8tFlsIze3AHSmAH4854l9YowEk)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF1xqghs1YpXbDofuv5EsnvKONRSoj1zRfhE-cHXqA_vPN_4d4zGUc2H_CiJWG1QhaMuxkKXwmlPZdXCtIHIGL3qiXigIlchKFf5tTi-FBtP5BGTHMZXxLRIH2asak5HdHPMlfr9NOFdsTCMXYGzfOP2CCOwH7hEgbR3JaSYzYXuLA-GAAgIyyMZ0)

### How Sleep Affects a Hangover

- **Gives your body time:** Sleeping lets hours pass while your system processes alcohol and inflammation settles. Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpwEBxCJF1-uUPh4kvw8XomGIWZnaGSv4E2KZx-DY5Ld7l_C168lIi23pPiYIdf7VkLqr5RCSuR4StYXA8tlAuJ4-y9cEh4r8ZGlURIekGrb4nPcgTNy5vjEZZUxMg_87u51W7bncG2lgV_mcDDuI7H_tm8HFnGk2vO0avaupi08e6L3fLF-eU1gX7Zpzgk2cBIW9BbMyoe_7ZZU8LaYfxUaPwuP35_NT5Q) agree in consensus that sleeping helps because it passes the time for the liver to clear toxins while you do not consciously feel the symptoms.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF1xqghs1YpXbDofuv5EsnvKONRSoj1zRfhE-cHXqA_vPN_4d4zGUc2H_CiJWG1QhaMuxkKXwmlPZdXCtIHIGL3qiXigIlchKFf5tTi-FBtP5BGTHMZXxLRIH2asak5HdHPMlfr9NOFdsTCMXYGzfOP2CCOwH7hEgbR3JaSYzYXuLA-GAAgIyyMZ0)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXnOWWpu2wOwxBCbDOpkIc-tSSkPSyUhtEPCpxzXY3fu6AVz26_5UfRg1Dyl0HaWIOck-dH9kjEKcOKyM-bg_hUUGPxRwUTX3O24FJ6ANQvHdJGFg3Zyh-2LiXTfnqN6v89yQzOV73o4WGh-D0VIlveeIGZw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpwEBxCJF1-uUPh4kvw8XomGIWZnaGSv4E2KZx-DY5Ld7l_C168lIi23pPiYIdf7VkLqr5RCSuR4StYXA8tlAuJ4-y9cEh4r8ZGlURIekGrb4nPcgTNy5vjEZZUxMg_87u51W7bncG2lgV_mcDDuI7H_tm8HFnGk2vO0avaupi08e6L3fLF-eU1gX7Zpzgk2cBIW9BbMyoe_7ZZU8LaYfxUaPwuP35_NT5Q)
- **Restores fragmented rest:** Alcohol disrupts normal sleep cycles, reduces REM sleep, and causes frequent waking. Extra rest or a short nap can help reduce fatigue and calm your brain.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXLwRCXOfWaz9NTAJ8STe05S6_aZXBWiAwEOp5ak6b83iAN6i3FHHQ5m84ludaelUQw3jLGH3GqfHX-5oIRPPtEqnfIiAgwODsBGwP5aFHPIYVYhfsY1vpOeFoBAyfs12BbvWvcmCxTVRe1Jbd_zI99wV1DNI)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXnOWWpu2wOwxBCbDOpkIc-tSSkPSyUhtEPCpxzXY3fu6AVz26_5UfRg1Dyl0HaWIOck-dH9kjEKcOKyM-bg_hUUGPxRwUTX3O24FJ6ANQvHdJGFg3Zyh-2LiXTfnqN6v89yQzOV73o4WGh-D0VIlveeIGZw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESrAEBxCJF142D4OG_z3HLgrU9mHAaRQWOiJv5JZZdIKMiroE6dGjeHTjm2wL3hE9-sJgfvDehPRiZCDvtGtXc8sarCQNRu63tgPrEFosv4og7WN7HU9f7Mpkxspr50rgyhfXRR4R0NlgSPooITrOYj9YqPtcUdQ7mzpPxz53hQMElJh5tulwNv8rRuwG2BA-W_mOVHiD5oI4w647BRXtkTssCWDSXcMtafwo9gzM7)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXuzl1IMIy-x5NeyYxkCn-z5z_5mbFG236NKR2pII2c_qoy3_7OJrij0POXBLj2b3NaedVjp7P2J7AmEsg0U7LaE7A-zu9c8OGdU-qEK1hJxG0Sk8tFlsIze3AHSmAH4854l9YowEk)
- **Limits what sleep can fix:** Sleep will not speed up alcohol metabolism. Long daytime naps can also make it harder to fall asleep later that night.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXLwRCXOfWaz9NTAJ8STe05S6_aZXBWiAwEOp5ak6b83iAN6i3FHHQ5m84ludaelUQw3jLGH3GqfHX-5oIRPPtEqnfIiAgwODsBGwP5aFHPIYVYhfsY1vpOeFoBAyfs12BbvWvcmCxTVRe1Jbd_zI99wV1DNI)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF1xqghs1YpXbDofuv5EsnvKONRSoj1zRfhE-cHXqA_vPN_4d4zGUc2H_CiJWG1QhaMuxkKXwmlPZdXCtIHIGL3qiXigIlchKFf5tTi-FBtP5BGTHMZXxLRIH2asak5HdHPMlfr9NOFdsTCMXYGzfOP2CCOwH7hEgbR3JaSYzYXuLA-GAAgIyyMZ0)

### Better Ways to Support Recovery
As noted by [Cleveland Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXnOWWpu2wOwxBCbDOpkIc-tSSkPSyUhtEPCpxzXY3fu6AVz26_5UfRg1Dyl0HaWIOck-dH9kjEKcOKyM-bg_hUUGPxRwUTX3O24FJ6ANQvHdJGFg3Zyh-2LiXTfnqN6v89yQzOV73o4WGh-D0VIlveeIGZw) , pair rest with basic self-care while you wait out the symptoms (typically 8 to 24 hours):[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXnOWWpu2wOwxBCbDOpkIc-tSSkPSyUhtEPCpxzXY3fu6AVz26_5UfRg1Dyl0HaWIOck-dH9kjEKcOKyM-bg_hUUGPxRwUTX3O24FJ6ANQvHdJGFg3Zyh-2LiXTfnqN6v89yQzOV73o4WGh-D0VIlveeIGZw)

- **Drink water** to replace fluids lost from drinking.
- **Eat plain carbs** to steady blood sugar and ease stomach upset.
- **Skip more alcohol** ("hair of the dog") and use pain relievers carefully, as acetaminophen can strain the liver and NSAIDs can irritate the stomach.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF16mTtEe43pIy4p09ZfePTsMgv6LC-znKpbCnOyaxs25felbHzZO9Y8E3fYVB5j5iSNY0Oj0vpDiCY4Vy_8KbigsRDLfVCDQX4_7Cx1fLXTkZDmN32S0HzEdFEn4m7hrDwrU9ddurmCF53_Y2SxBSacr1eMM_l1OlLhhIfKGyB1HYAbuwRQh3N_4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXnOWWpu2wOwxBCbDOpkIc-tSSkPSyUhtEPCpxzXY3fu6AVz26_5UfRg1Dyl0HaWIOck-dH9kjEKcOKyM-bg_hUUGPxRwUTX3O24FJ6ANQvHdJGFg3Zyh-2LiXTfnqN6v89yQzOV73o4WGh-D0VIlveeIGZw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF1xqghs1YpXbDofuv5EsnvKONRSoj1zRfhE-cHXqA_vPN_4d4zGUc2H_CiJWG1QhaMuxkKXwmlPZdXCtIHIGL3qiXigIlchKFf5tTi-FBtP5BGTHMZXxLRIH2asak5HdHPMlfr9NOFdsTCMXYGzfOP2CCOwH7hEgbR3JaSYzYXuLA-GAAgIyyMZ0)

For more details on how alcohol fragments rest and affects daytime fatigue, see [How sleep affects a hangover](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXLwRCXOfWaz9NTAJ8STe05S6_aZXBWiAwEOp5ak6b83iAN6i3FHHQ5m84ludaelUQw3jLGH3GqfHX-5oIRPPtEqnfIiAgwODsBGwP5aFHPIYVYhfsY1vpOeFoBAyfs12BbvWvcmCxTVRe1Jbd_zI99wV1DNI).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXLwRCXOfWaz9NTAJ8STe05S6_aZXBWiAwEOp5ak6b83iAN6i3FHHQ5m84ludaelUQw3jLGH3GqfHX-5oIRPPtEqnfIiAgwODsBGwP5aFHPIYVYhfsY1vpOeFoBAyfs12BbvWvcmCxTVRe1Jbd_zI99wV1DNI)If you are looking for ways to ease specific **symptoms** (like nausea, headaches, or poor sleep), or want tips on **preventing** hangovers next time, let me know what you would like to focus on.
